schema_version.description: Optional in Phase 1; will become required once REQ meta migrations begin.

initial_phase.description: Optional initial TDD phase, set by qgb tdd-init.

stage_id.description: Must match an id defined in policy.json#/stages.

contract_ref.description: Workspace-relative path to the contract.json for this stage.

required.description: Phase 1: must be true if present. Phase 1 treats every adopted stage as judgement material because the curated gate.schema.json requires every stages[] entry to be passed for ALLOW. Optional-stage semantics (advisory checks) is a Phase 2 design surface (waivers + knowledge); writing required=false here in Phase 1 would silently mislead the designer about which stages affect ALLOW.
